name: Sample: SAP Sales & Finance
description: SAP-style SD and FI tables (orders, deliveries, billing, accounting documents) for a demo manufacturer - 3 company codes, Jan 2024 to Nov 2026.

dictionary.title: SAP field dictionary - Sales & Distribution (SD)
dictionary.content:
-- Table names are the SAP names in lower case; field names are the SAP technical names. Text tables have one row per language (SPRAS): always filter SPRAS = 'E'.
-- kna1  Customer master (general): KUNNR customer number (10 digits, leading zeros, e.g. '0000100001'); NAME1 customer name; LAND1 country (ISO 2); ORT01 city; PSTLZ postcode; BRSCH industry (join t016t); KTOKD account group; ERDAT created on; LOEVM deletion flag ('X' = flagged).
-- knvv  Customer sales-area data: KUNNR; VKORG sales organisation; VTWEG distribution channel; SPART division ('00' = cross-division); KDGRP customer group (join t151t: 01 Key account, 02 Standard, 03 Small customer); BZIRK sales district; ZTERM payment terms (join tvzbt); WAERS currency.
-- mara  Material master: MATNR material number (e.g. 'PMP-1001'); MTART material type (FERT finished product, HAWA trading goods / spare parts, DIEN service); MATKL material group = product line (join t023t: PUMPS, VALVES, MOTORS, SPARES, SERVICE); MEINS base unit; BRGEW gross weight; GEWEI weight unit; ERSDA created on; LVORM deletion flag.
-- makt  Material descriptions: MATNR, SPRAS language, MAKTX description.
-- mbew  Material valuation: MATNR, BWKEY valuation area = plant, VPRSV price control (S standard), STPRS standard cost per PEINH units, WAERS.
-- vbak  Sales document header (quotations, orders, returns): VBELN document number; ERDAT created on (= order date); AUART document type (QT quotation, OR standard order, RE returns, CR credit memo request; texts in tvakt); VBTYP category (B quotation, C order, H returns, K credit memo request); VKORG sales org; VTWEG channel; SPART division; KUNNR sold-to customer; NETWR net value in document currency (excludes rejected items); WAERK document currency; VDATU requested delivery date (for quotations: valid-to date); VGBEL reference document (for an order created from a quotation: the quotation number); GBSTK overall status (A not yet processed, B partially processed, C completely processed); BSTNK customer purchase order number; ERNAM created by.
-- vbap  Sales document items: VBELN, POSNR item ('000010'); MATNR; KWMENG order quantity; VRKME sales unit; ARKTX item text; NETWR item net value; WAERK; WERKS delivering plant; ABGRU rejection reason (empty = not rejected; texts in tvagt); PSTYV item category; VGBEL/VGPOS reference quotation and item; MATKL material group.
-- likp  Outbound delivery header: VBELN delivery number; ERDAT created on; LFART delivery type (LF); VKORG; VSTEL shipping point (= plant); KUNNR ship-to; LFDAT planned delivery date (promised to the customer); WADAT planned goods issue; WADAT_IST actual goods issue date (= shipped); WBSTK goods movement status (C = goods issued).
-- lips  Delivery items: VBELN, POSNR, MATNR, LFIMG delivered quantity, VRKME, VGBEL sales order number, VGPOS sales order item, WERKS plant.
-- vbrk  Billing document header: VBELN billing number; FKART billing type (F2 invoice, G2 credit memo, S1 invoice cancellation); VBTYP category (M invoice, O credit memo, N cancellation); FKDAT billing date (revenue date); ERDAT; VKORG; VTWEG; BUKRS company code; KUNAG sold-to; KUNRG payer; NETWR net value (always positive); MWSBK tax amount; WAERK currency; ZTERM payment terms; FKSTO 'X' = this invoice has been cancelled; SFAKN for an S1 document: the invoice it cancels.
-- vbrp  Billing items: VBELN, POSNR, MATNR, ARKTX, FKIMG billed quantity, VRKME, NETWR item net value (always positive), WAVWR cost of the item in document currency (for margin), AUBEL/AUPOS sales order and item, VGBEL/VGPOS delivery and item, WERKS plant, MATKL material group, PRCTR profit centre.
-- Organisation & texts: t001 company codes (BUKRS, BUTXT name, LAND1, WAERS currency, KTOPL chart of accounts, PERIV fiscal year variant); tvko sales org -> company code (VKORG, BUKRS, WAERS); tvkot sales org names (VKORG, SPRAS, VTEXT); tvtwt channel names (VTWEG, SPRAS, VTEXT: 10 Direct sales, 20 Distributors, 30 Online shop); t001w plants (WERKS, NAME1, BWKEY, BUKRS, LAND1); tvakt document type names (AUART, SPRAS, BEZEI); tvagt rejection reasons (ABGRU, SPRAS, BEZEI); t016t industries (BRSCH, SPRAS, BRTXT); t023t material groups (MATKL, SPRAS, WGBEZ); t151t customer groups (KDGRP, SPRAS, KTEXT); tvzbt payment terms (ZTERM, SPRAS, VTEXT).

dictionary.title: SAP field dictionary - Finance (FI / CO)
dictionary.content:
-- bkpf  Accounting document header: BUKRS company code; BELNR document number (10 digits); GJAHR fiscal year (= calendar year, variant K4); BLART document type (RV billing/revenue from SD, DZ customer payment, WL goods issue cost of sales, KR vendor invoice, KZ vendor payment, SA G/L posting e.g. payroll); BLDAT document date; BUDAT posting date; MONAT posting period (= month 1-12); WAERS currency; XBLNR reference (for RV: the billing document number); AWTYP/AWKEY source object (VBRK + billing number for SD invoices); USNAM posted by; STBLG reversed by document (filled on a reversed document).
-- bseg  Accounting line items. Key: BUKRS + BELNR + GJAHR (join to bkpf on all three) + BUZEI line. BSCHL posting key; KOART account type (D customer, K vendor, S general ledger); SHKZG debit/credit indicator (S = debit, H = credit); DMBTR amount in company-code currency, always positive - the sign comes from SHKZG; WRBTR amount in document currency; HKONT G/L account (10 digits with leading zeros, e.g. '0000400000'); KUNNR customer (customer lines); LIFNR vendor (vendor lines); KOSTL cost centre (expense lines); PRCTR profit centre (revenue lines); ZFBDT baseline date for payment; ZTERM payment terms; ZBD1T days until due (net due date = ZFBDT + ZBD1T days); AUGDT clearing date and AUGBL clearing document (both empty = open item, not yet paid); VBELN billing document (SD-originated lines); SGTXT line text.
-- ska1  G/L account master (chart INT): KTOPL, SAKNR account (10 digits), XBILK 'X' = balance-sheet account (empty = P&L account), GVTYP P&L statement type, KTOKS account group (ASSETS, LIABILITIES, REVENUE, COGS, OPEX).
-- skat  G/L account names: SPRAS, KTOPL, SAKNR, TXT20 short text, TXT50 long text.
-- csks  Cost centres: KOKRS controlling area, KOSTL cost centre, BUKRS, KOSAR category, VERAK person responsible, PRCTR, DATAB/DATBI validity.  cskt  cost centre names: KOKRS, KOSTL, SPRAS, KTEXT.
-- cepct Profit centre names: PRCTR (PC-PUMPS, PC-VALVES, PC-MOTORS, PC-SPARES, PC-SERVICE), SPRAS, KTEXT.
-- lfa1  Vendor master: LIFNR vendor (10 digits), NAME1, LAND1, ORT01, KTOKK account group, ERDAT.

documentation.title: About this data
documentation.content: This is a sample copy of SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) and Financial Accounting (FI) tables for Acme Industrial, a manufacturer of pumps, valves, motors, spare parts and services. Three company codes, each with one sales organisation of the same number: 1000 Acme Industrial GmbH (Germany, EUR), 2000 Acme Industrial Inc. (USA, USD), 3000 Acme Industrial Ltd (UK, GBP). Data runs from January 2024 and was extracted on 2026-11-15 - use DATE '2026-11-15' as "today" (for ageing, overdue items and "last 30 days") unless the user names another date. Company codes, sales orgs and channels are stored as numbers (BUKRS = 1000); customer, vendor and G/L account numbers are text with leading zeros.

documentation.title: Currencies - never add up different currencies
documentation.content: Amounts are in the currency of their company code / sales organisation: EUR for 1000, USD for 2000, GBP for 3000 (VBAK.WAERK, VBRK.WAERK, BKPF.WAERS, T001.WAERS). Never sum amounts across company codes or currencies into one number. When a question covers several company codes, group by company code or sales organisation and show the currency next to the amount. There is no exchange-rate table in this data set.

documentation.title: Net sales (revenue) from billing documents
documentation.content: Net sales = billed net value from VBRK (header) or VBRP (items) by billing date FKDAT. Invoices (VBTYP 'M', FKART F2) count positive; credit memos (VBTYP 'O', FKART G2) and invoice cancellations (VBTYP 'N', FKART S1) count negative: SUM(CASE WHEN VBTYP = 'M' THEN NETWR ELSE -NETWR END). NETWR is stored positive on every billing document. A cancelled invoice (FKSTO = 'X') is offset by its S1 document, so the signed sum is already correct. Sales orders (VBAK) are order intake / bookings, not revenue. Gross sales including tax = NETWR + MWSBK. "Sales", "revenue", "turnover" and "Umsatz" all mean net sales.

documentation.title: Gross margin and cost of sales
documentation.content: Gross margin per billing item = VBRP.NETWR - VBRP.WAVWR (WAVWR is the cost of the goods sold, in the same currency). Margin % = 1 - SUM(WAVWR) / SUM(NETWR). Use the same sign rule as net sales (VBTYP from VBRK: M positive, O and N negative). In Finance the cost of sales is posted to G/L account 0000500000 (document type WL at goods issue).

documentation.title: Order intake, backlog and order status
documentation.content: Order intake = sales orders (VBAK.AUART = 'OR') by order date ERDAT, value VBAK.NETWR (already excludes rejected items). Quotations (AUART 'QT'), returns ('RE') and credit memo requests ('CR') are also in VBAK - filter AUART = 'OR' for orders. Open order backlog = standard orders with GBSTK in ('A', 'B') (not completely processed). Rejected items have VBAP.ABGRU filled (reason texts in TVAGT); they are never delivered or billed.

documentation.title: Quotations and conversion rate
documentation.content: A quotation is VBAK with AUART = 'QT'. When an order is created from a quotation, the order's VBAK.VGBEL holds the quotation number (and VBAP.VGBEL / VGPOS on the items). Quote conversion rate = quotations referenced by at least one order / all quotations. Quotation GBSTK 'C' = converted (completely referenced), 'A' = open or lost. VDATU on a quotation is its valid-to date.

documentation.title: Document flow: order to delivery to invoice to accounting
documentation.content: Sales order VBAK/VBAP -> delivery LIKP/LIPS (LIPS.VGBEL = order VBELN, LIPS.VGPOS = order POSNR) -> billing VBRK/VBRP (VBRP.AUBEL/AUPOS = order and item, VBRP.VGBEL/VGPOS = delivery and item) -> accounting document BKPF/BSEG (BKPF.BLART 'RV', BKPF.AWKEY = BKPF.XBLNR = billing VBELN, and BSEG.VBELN = billing VBELN on every line). Delivery header LIKP has no order number; go through LIPS.

documentation.title: Delivery performance (on-time delivery, OTD)
documentation.content: A delivery is on time when the actual goods issue date LIKP.WADAT_IST is on or before the planned delivery date LIKP.LFDAT. On-time delivery % = share of deliveries on time, normally reported by month of WADAT_IST. Days late = WADAT_IST - LFDAT when positive. Order-to-ship lead time = LIKP.WADAT_IST - VBAK.ERDAT (via LIPS.VGBEL). Plant = LIKP.VSTEL or LIPS.WERKS (names in T001W).

documentation.title: Debit / credit and signs in FI (BSEG)
documentation.content: BSEG.DMBTR is always positive. SHKZG gives the side: 'S' = debit (Soll), 'H' = credit (Haben). Signed amount = CASE WHEN SHKZG = 'S' THEN DMBTR ELSE -DMBTR END. Revenue accounts are credited, so revenue = -(signed amount) = SUM(CASE WHEN SHKZG = 'H' THEN DMBTR ELSE -DMBTR END). Expenses and cost of sales are debited, so expense = signed amount. Every document balances: signed amounts of one BELNR sum to zero. Join BSEG to BKPF on BUKRS, BELNR and GJAHR (all three) to get posting date BUDAT, period MONAT and document type BLART.

documentation.title: Chart of accounts and P&L structure
documentation.content: G/L accounts (SKA1 / SKAT, chart INT, numbers with leading zeros): 0000113100 Bank; 0000121000 Receivables (customer reconciliation account); 0000154000 Input tax; 0000790000 Finished goods inventory; 0000160000 Payables (vendor reconciliation account); 0000175000 Output tax; 0000400000 Sales revenue - domestic; 0000410000 Sales revenue - export; 0000500000 Cost of goods sold; 0000610000 Rent and facilities; 0000620000 Utilities; 0000630000 Travel; 0000640000 IT and software; 0000650000 Marketing; 0000660000 Salaries and wages; 0000670000 Professional services; 0000680000 Freight out. P&L accounts have SKA1.XBILK empty; SKA1.KTOKS groups them: REVENUE, COGS, OPEX. Gross profit = revenue - COGS; operating profit (EBIT) = gross profit - OPEX. Revenue accounts 0000400000-0000410000 carry PRCTR (profit centre = product line); expense lines carry KOSTL (cost centre).

documentation.title: Accounts receivable: open items, overdue and ageing
documentation.content: Customer items are BSEG lines with KOART = 'D' (KUNNR filled). An open item has AUGBL empty (NULL); a cleared (paid) item has AUGDT = payment date and AUGBL = payment document. Open receivables balance = SUM(CASE WHEN SHKZG = 'S' THEN DMBTR ELSE -DMBTR END) over open customer items. Net due date = ZFBDT + CAST(ZBD1T AS INTEGER) (ZFBDT is a DATE; ZBD1T days). Overdue = net due date before the key date DATE '2026-11-15'. Days overdue = DATE '2026-11-15' - net due date. Standard ageing buckets on days overdue: Not yet due, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, over 90. Report receivables per company code (currencies differ).

documentation.title: Payment behaviour and DSO
documentation.content: Days to pay for a paid invoice = AUGDT - ZFBDT on the customer invoice line (KOART 'D', SHKZG 'S', AUGDT filled). Days late = AUGDT - (ZFBDT + ZBD1T). Payment terms: ZB30 net 30 days, ZB45 net 45, ZB60 net 60 (TVZBT). DSO (days sales outstanding) = open receivables / gross invoiced sales of the last 90 days * 90, per company code, as of DATE '2026-11-15'.

documentation.title: Costs: cost centres, vendors and payroll
documentation.content: Operating expenses are debit lines (SHKZG 'S') on OPEX accounts with a cost centre KOSTL. Cost centre numbers: first digit = company code (1 = 1000, 2 = 2000, 3 = 3000), next two = function: 10 Sales, 20 Marketing, 30 Administration, 40 IT, 50 Logistics, 60 Service delivery (e.g. 11000 = Sales Germany, 24000 = IT USA). Names in CSKT (SPRAS 'E'). Vendor invoices are BKPF.BLART = 'KR'; the vendor line has KOART 'K' and LIFNR, credit side, gross amount incl. tax. Vendor spend (net) = expense lines of KR documents. Payroll is posted monthly with BLART 'SA' to 0000660000 per cost centre.

documentation.title: Customers, regions and segments
documentation.content: Customer country = KNA1.LAND1. Industry = KNA1.BRSCH (texts T016T: CHEM Chemicals, OILG Oil & gas, WATR Water utilities, FOOD Food & beverage, MINE Mining, BLDG Building services). Customer group = KNVV.KDGRP (01 Key account, 02 Standard, 03 Small customer). Sales district = KNVV.BZIRK. Export sale = customer country different from the company code country (posted to revenue account 0000410000). Each customer belongs to exactly one sales organisation (KNVV.VKORG); on billing documents the payer is VBRK.KUNRG.

examples.question: What are net sales by month for each company code?
examples.sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', k.FKDAT) AS month, k.BUKRS AS company_code, k.WAERK AS currency,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN k.VBTYP = 'M' THEN k.NETWR ELSE -k.NETWR END), 2) AS net_sales
FROM vbrk k
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1, 2

examples.question: Net sales by sales organisation in 2025
examples.sql:
SELECT k.VKORG AS sales_org, t.VTEXT AS sales_org_name, k.WAERK AS currency,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN k.VBTYP = 'M' THEN k.NETWR ELSE -k.NETWR END), 2) AS net_sales
FROM vbrk k
JOIN tvkot t ON t.VKORG = k.VKORG AND t.SPRAS = 'E'
WHERE k.FKDAT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1

examples.question: Who were our top 10 customers by net sales in Germany in 2025?
examples.sql:
SELECT c.KUNNR AS customer, c.NAME1 AS customer_name, c.LAND1 AS country,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN k.VBTYP = 'M' THEN k.NETWR ELSE -k.NETWR END), 2) AS net_sales_eur
FROM vbrk k
JOIN kna1 c ON c.KUNNR = k.KUNRG
WHERE k.VKORG = 1000 AND k.FKDAT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY net_sales_eur DESC
LIMIT 10

examples.question: Net sales and gross margin by product line for 2025
examples.sql:
SELECT k.BUKRS AS company_code, k.WAERK AS currency, g.WGBEZ AS product_line,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN k.VBTYP = 'M' THEN p.NETWR ELSE -p.NETWR END), 2) AS net_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN k.VBTYP = 'M' THEN p.NETWR - p.WAVWR ELSE -(p.NETWR - p.WAVWR) END), 2) AS gross_margin,
       ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN k.VBTYP = 'M' THEN p.NETWR - p.WAVWR ELSE -(p.NETWR - p.WAVWR) END)
             / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN k.VBTYP = 'M' THEN p.NETWR ELSE -p.NETWR END), 0), 1) AS margin_pct
FROM vbrp p
JOIN vbrk k ON k.VBELN = p.VBELN
JOIN t023t g ON g.MATKL = p.MATKL AND g.SPRAS = 'E'
WHERE k.FKDAT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1, net_sales DESC

examples.question: What is the open sales order backlog by sales organisation?
examples.sql:
SELECT h.VKORG AS sales_org, t.VTEXT AS sales_org_name, h.WAERK AS currency,
       COUNT(*) AS open_orders, ROUND(SUM(h.NETWR), 2) AS backlog_value
FROM vbak h
JOIN tvkot t ON t.VKORG = h.VKORG AND t.SPRAS = 'E'
WHERE h.AUART = 'OR' AND h.GBSTK IN ('A', 'B')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1

examples.question: What is our on-time delivery rate by month?
examples.sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', WADAT_IST) AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS deliveries,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN WADAT_IST <= LFDAT THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS on_time_pct
FROM likp
WHERE WADAT_IST IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

examples.question: What is the quotation conversion rate by sales organisation?
examples.sql:
SELECT q.VKORG AS sales_org,
       COUNT(*) AS quotations,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vbak o WHERE o.AUART = 'OR' AND o.VGBEL = q.VBELN)) AS converted,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vbak o WHERE o.AUART = 'OR' AND o.VGBEL = q.VBELN)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS conversion_pct
FROM vbak q
WHERE q.AUART = 'QT'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

examples.question: Why are order items rejected?
examples.sql:
SELECT r.BEZEI AS rejection_reason, COUNT(*) AS items, i.WAERK AS currency, ROUND(SUM(i.NETWR), 2) AS lost_value
FROM vbap i
JOIN vbak h ON h.VBELN = i.VBELN AND h.AUART = 'OR'
JOIN tvagt r ON r.ABGRU = i.ABGRU AND r.SPRAS = 'E'
WHERE i.ABGRU IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY 3, lost_value DESC

examples.question: Show the accounts receivable ageing by company code
examples.sql:
WITH open_items AS (
  SELECT BUKRS, CASE WHEN SHKZG = 'S' THEN DMBTR ELSE -DMBTR END AS amount,
         DATE '2026-11-15' - (ZFBDT + CAST(COALESCE(ZBD1T, 0) AS INTEGER)) AS days_overdue
  FROM bseg
  WHERE KOART = 'D' AND AUGBL IS NULL
)
SELECT o.BUKRS AS company_code, t.WAERS AS currency,
       ROUND(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE days_overdue <= 0), 2) AS not_yet_due,
       ROUND(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE days_overdue BETWEEN 1 AND 30), 2) AS overdue_1_30,
       ROUND(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE days_overdue BETWEEN 31 AND 60), 2) AS overdue_31_60,
       ROUND(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE days_overdue BETWEEN 61 AND 90), 2) AS overdue_61_90,
       ROUND(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE days_overdue > 90), 2) AS overdue_over_90,
       ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_open
FROM open_items o
JOIN t001 t ON t.BUKRS = o.BUKRS
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

examples.question: Which customers have the most overdue receivables?
examples.sql:
SELECT b.BUKRS AS company_code, c.KUNNR AS customer, c.NAME1 AS customer_name,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.SHKZG = 'S' THEN b.DMBTR ELSE -b.DMBTR END), 2) AS overdue_amount,
       MAX(DATE '2026-11-15' - (b.ZFBDT + CAST(b.ZBD1T AS INTEGER))) AS max_days_overdue
FROM bseg b
JOIN kna1 c ON c.KUNNR = b.KUNNR
WHERE b.KOART = 'D' AND b.AUGBL IS NULL
  AND b.ZFBDT + CAST(COALESCE(b.ZBD1T, 0) AS INTEGER) < DATE '2026-11-15'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY overdue_amount DESC
LIMIT 15

examples.question: What is the average number of days customers take to pay, by customer group?
examples.sql:
SELECT v.VKORG AS sales_org, g.KTEXT AS customer_group,
       COUNT(*) AS paid_invoices,
       ROUND(AVG(b.AUGDT - b.ZFBDT), 1) AS avg_days_to_pay,
       ROUND(AVG(b.AUGDT - (b.ZFBDT + CAST(b.ZBD1T AS INTEGER))), 1) AS avg_days_late
FROM bseg b
JOIN knvv v ON v.KUNNR = b.KUNNR
JOIN t151t g ON g.KDGRP = v.KDGRP AND g.SPRAS = 'E'
WHERE b.KOART = 'D' AND b.SHKZG = 'S' AND b.AUGDT IS NOT NULL AND b.ZBD1T IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

examples.question: Show the profit and loss statement for company code 1000 in 2025
examples.sql:
SELECT a.KTOKS AS section, b.HKONT AS gl_account, s.TXT50 AS account_name,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.SHKZG = 'H' THEN b.DMBTR ELSE -b.DMBTR END), 2) AS amount_eur
FROM bseg b
JOIN ska1 a ON a.SAKNR = b.HKONT
JOIN skat s ON s.SAKNR = b.HKONT AND s.SPRAS = 'E'
WHERE b.BUKRS = 1000 AND b.GJAHR = 2025 AND COALESCE(a.XBILK, '') = ''
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY CASE a.KTOKS WHEN 'REVENUE' THEN 1 WHEN 'COGS' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, 2

examples.question: What is gross profit and operating profit by company code and year?
examples.sql:
SELECT b.BUKRS AS company_code, b.GJAHR AS fiscal_year, t.WAERS AS currency,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN a.KTOKS = 'REVENUE' THEN x END), 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(-SUM(CASE WHEN a.KTOKS = 'COGS' THEN x END), 2) AS cost_of_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN a.KTOKS IN ('REVENUE', 'COGS') THEN x END), 2) AS gross_profit,
       ROUND(-SUM(CASE WHEN a.KTOKS = 'OPEX' THEN x END), 2) AS operating_expenses,
       ROUND(SUM(x), 2) AS operating_profit
FROM (SELECT BUKRS, GJAHR, HKONT, CASE WHEN SHKZG = 'H' THEN DMBTR ELSE -DMBTR END AS x FROM bseg) b
JOIN ska1 a ON a.SAKNR = b.HKONT AND COALESCE(a.XBILK, '') = ''
JOIN t001 t ON t.BUKRS = b.BUKRS
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1, 2

examples.question: Operating expenses by cost centre for 2025
examples.sql:
SELECT b.BUKRS AS company_code, b.KOSTL AS cost_centre, c.KTEXT AS cost_centre_name, t.WAERS AS currency,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.SHKZG = 'S' THEN b.DMBTR ELSE -b.DMBTR END), 2) AS expenses
FROM bseg b
JOIN ska1 a ON a.SAKNR = b.HKONT AND a.KTOKS = 'OPEX'
JOIN cskt c ON c.KOSTL = b.KOSTL AND c.SPRAS = 'E'
JOIN t001 t ON t.BUKRS = b.BUKRS
WHERE b.GJAHR = 2025
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
ORDER BY 1, expenses DESC

examples.question: Who are our top 10 vendors by spend?
examples.sql:
SELECT v.LIFNR AS vendor, v.NAME1 AS vendor_name, b.BUKRS AS company_code, t.WAERS AS currency,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.BELNR) AS invoices, ROUND(SUM(b.DMBTR), 2) AS gross_spend
FROM bseg b
JOIN bkpf h ON h.BUKRS = b.BUKRS AND h.BELNR = b.BELNR AND h.GJAHR = b.GJAHR AND h.BLART = 'KR'
JOIN lfa1 v ON v.LIFNR = b.LIFNR
JOIN t001 t ON t.BUKRS = b.BUKRS
WHERE b.KOART = 'K' AND b.SHKZG = 'H'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
ORDER BY gross_spend DESC
LIMIT 10

examples.question: Do billing revenue in SD and revenue in FI reconcile by month?
examples.sql:
WITH sd AS (
  SELECT BUKRS, DATE_TRUNC('month', FKDAT) AS month, SUM(CASE WHEN VBTYP = 'M' THEN NETWR ELSE -NETWR END) AS sd_net_sales
  FROM vbrk GROUP BY 1, 2
), fi AS (
  SELECT b.BUKRS, DATE_TRUNC('month', h.BUDAT) AS month, SUM(CASE WHEN b.SHKZG = 'H' THEN b.DMBTR ELSE -b.DMBTR END) AS fi_revenue
  FROM bseg b
  JOIN bkpf h ON h.BUKRS = b.BUKRS AND h.BELNR = b.BELNR AND h.GJAHR = b.GJAHR
  WHERE b.HKONT IN ('0000400000', '0000410000')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT sd.BUKRS AS company_code, sd.month, ROUND(sd_net_sales, 2) AS sd_net_sales, ROUND(fi_revenue, 2) AS fi_revenue,
       ROUND(sd_net_sales - COALESCE(fi_revenue, 0), 2) AS difference
FROM sd LEFT JOIN fi ON fi.BUKRS = sd.BUKRS AND fi.month = sd.month
ORDER BY 1, 2

examples.question: How long does it take from order to shipment, by plant?
examples.sql:
SELECT d.VSTEL AS plant, w.NAME1 AS plant_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.VBELN) AS deliveries,
       ROUND(AVG(d.WADAT_IST - o.ERDAT), 1) AS avg_days_order_to_ship
FROM likp d
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT VBELN, VGBEL FROM lips) l ON l.VBELN = d.VBELN
JOIN vbak o ON o.VBELN = l.VGBEL
JOIN t001w w ON w.WERKS = d.VSTEL
WHERE d.WADAT_IST IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

examples.question: How much of our sales were credit memos and cancellations?
examples.sql:
SELECT BUKRS AS company_code, WAERK AS currency,
       ROUND(SUM(NETWR) FILTER (WHERE VBTYP = 'M'), 2) AS invoiced,
       ROUND(SUM(NETWR) FILTER (WHERE VBTYP = 'O'), 2) AS credit_memos,
       ROUND(SUM(NETWR) FILTER (WHERE VBTYP = 'N'), 2) AS cancellations,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(NETWR) FILTER (WHERE VBTYP IN ('O', 'N')) / SUM(NETWR) FILTER (WHERE VBTYP = 'M'), 2) AS reduction_pct
FROM vbrk
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

examples.question: Forecast monthly net sales for Germany for the next 6 months
examples.sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', FKDAT) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN VBTYP = 'M' THEN NETWR ELSE -NETWR END), 2) AS net_sales_eur
FROM vbrk
WHERE VKORG = 1000 AND FKDAT < DATE '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
